name: ingest-document
description: Learn attached documents (books, handbooks, policies, articles) into a base memory or a session: the facts, relations, rules and procedures they state, as validated knowledge wires with provenance (source, location, quote). Use when the user asks to learn, ingest, remember or add a document to a knowledge base or to the conversation.

rights.description: the source rights of the attachments, as the user stated them (DS011); required: without it nothing is ingested

purpose.description: what the knowledge will be used for, in the user's words

source_url.description: where the document comes from, when the user gave it

version.description: v1: one authoring conversation per chunk (lib/ingest/direct-author.mjs); v2: structure pass, canonical vocabulary, FOL per sentence and the converter (lib/ingest/v2). A session target needs v2

tier.description: v1: the tier that writes the knowledge wires; v2: the tier of the structure role

fol_tier.description: v2: the tier of the FOL role and its repair (default medium, with reasoning)

merge_tier.description: v2: the tier that decides the conflicts of the canonical vocabulary (one call per document)

max_chunk_bytes.description: the largest chunk of a document handled in one call (default 7000 for v1, 3000 for v2)

_note: Wraps the product's document ingestion: v1 = Ingestions.draft (lib/ingest/index.mjs: chunking, the sop-wire-authoring skill, the validator and source checks in the repair loop, memory conflict checks, storage with provenance); v2 = ingestV2 (lib/ingest/v2: structure role over all chunks, a canonical vocabulary layer, the FOL role fol-v2 per sentence over that vocabulary, the deterministic converter, the validator, the contradiction and quote checks, escalations.jsonl, storage with provenance into a base memory or a session). The adapter only routes its model calls through the endpoint's tiers, tagged with the task's purpose and run id.
